deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Primary brand color, dominant borders, body text, icon strokes, link color — saturates the interface like violet ink on parchment

amethyst.$description: Amethyst — Secondary brand violet for mid-weight text, secondary borders, and decorative iconography

iris-glow.$description: Iris Glow — Filled primary action button background — the only filled CTA color, used sparingly to make Book a demo / Sign up commands feel switched on

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Soft violet-tinted surface for cards, table rows, and section backgrounds

parchment.$description: Parchment — Primary page canvas — warm off-white, the base layer everything sits on

licheno.$description: Licheno — Mint-tinted card surface for testimonial and feature cards

apricot-wash.$description: Apricot Wash — Peach-tinted card surface for warm-coded testimonial cards

rose-quartz.$description: Rose Quartz — Pink-tinted card surface for pink-themed testimonial cards

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Blue-tinted card surface for blue-themed testimonial cards

lavender-veil.$description: Lavender Veil — Muted violet surface for table headers, footer accents, and subtle dividers

orchid-pink.$description: Orchid Pink — Vivid pink accent for specimen-card borders, icon fills, and decorative illustration strokes

tangerine.$description: Tangerine — Vivid orange accent for specimen-card borders, icon strokes, and secondary callouts

forest-fern.$description: Forest Fern — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Vivid blue accent for specimen-card borders and tech iconography

peacock.$description: Peacock — Vivid teal accent for specimen-card borders and unique illustration touches

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Secondary blue border for grid-card variants and icon strokes

plum.$description: Plum — Deep maroon for text emphasis, badge labels, and inline highlights on warm cards

crimson.$description: Crimson — Red accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

vermilion.$description: Vermilion — Red decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

pure.$description: Pure — Card foreground, inverted text on dark surfaces, base layer for product screenshot cards

reckless.$description: Display and editorial headlines, hero statements, and section titles. The 300-weight headlines with negative letter-spacing (as tight as -0.030em at 72px) create a quiet, confident serif voice that contrasts the playful sans body

roobert.$description: Body text, navigation, buttons, labels, and all UI microcopy. Carries positive letter-spacing (0.007em–0.100em) at small sizes, giving uppercase tags and nav a spaced, instrument-label quality
